sloka: स तदा राक्षसेन्द्रेण सम्दिष्टो रजनीचरः ।शुको विहम्गमो भूत्वा तूर्णमाप्लुत्य चाम्बरम् ॥६-२०-१३॥।।
transliteration: sa tadā rākṣasendreṇa samdiṣṭo rajanīcaraḥ ।śuko vihamgamo bhūtvā tūrṇamāplutya cāmbaram ॥6-20-13॥।।

translations.english: Thus, commanded by the ruler of Rakshasas, Suka immediately transformed into a bird form and rose apace into the sky.
